verdict.rationale: The Parallel Runner directly delivers the story: bounded concurrent fan-out across independent kanban tasks, data items or complete commands, with structured evidence for every item. It is complemented by `yy loop` for sequential repetition and Run-Until-Completion for draining open kanban work. Missing for 10: bulk mutation of Ledger records (e.g. batch status or tag updates) is not shown, the docs are thin one-line claims without detailed usage or limits, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
